topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: Got a new case, and if you think about it, it’s the kind that makes you question the human soul. Some bright spark decided it was a good idea to tattoo an artist’s work on their skin. Now, the artist’s here, hat in hand, asking for help to find the ink-slinger. I took one look at the sketch he handed over and I could see it – the angles, the shadows, the way the lines curved. This wasn’t just a copy, this was a damn near perfect rendition. I nodded, gave the artist a firm handshake. Told him I’d get to the bottom of it. Didn’t mention the satisfaction I felt seeing the grit in his eyes. Cases like these, they remind me why I stick to this line of work.
